title: Goods and Services Tax (GST) Fundamentals in India
source: CBIC, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services across India. GST subsumed several central and state indirect taxes including Excise Duty, Service Tax, VAT, and Sales Tax. GST operates under a dual structure: Central GST (CGST) levied by the Central Government on intrastate supplies, State GST (SGST) levied by State Governments on intrastate supplies, and Integrated GST (IGST) levied by the Central Government on interstate supplies and imports. Common GST rate slabs across India are 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%.
